sentences.text: In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
We trained each model for 100 epochs with a batch size of 128.
Each experiment was repeated 3 times with different random seeds.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy during training.
As shown in Figure 1, at epoch 10, EfficientNet achieves 58% test accuracy.
As shown in Figure 1, DistilBERT outperforms EfficientNet by 10.8 percentage points at epoch 30.
From epoch 30 to epoch 50, the test accuracy of EfficientNet improves by a relative 25.9%.
At epoch 30, DistilBERT is 9.3 points better than EfficientNet.
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy of MLP by dataset.
On MNIST, MLP obtains a validation accuracy of 76%.
MLP scores 8.7 points higher on IMDB than on MNIST (Figure 2).
MLP scores 3.1 points higher on SST-2 than on SVHN (Figure 2).
On CIFAR-10, MLP obtains a validation accuracy of 89.8% (Figure 2).
Logistic Regression reaches 69.6% accuracy on QQP.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
